coverage.non_warrant_content: P001 also selects the prospective newly created-account cohort as operational setup. P002 and P003 are covered by the hypothesis, limitation, assumption and methodological claims.

P004 specifies a common initial pathway and observation conditions. P006 supplies the observation schedule and question topics: next action, information availability, offline preparation and intended roster date. P007 instructs recording repeated progress, waiting and return transitions with multiple or unknown reasons permitted. These are procedural setup, not assertions that transitions or particular reasons have been observed. P008–P013 contribute the bounds, decision rules and comparison constraints annotated above.

P016 specifies inclusive reporting of accounts with no return or incomplete follow-up alongside published accounts. P017 specifies the comparison readouts: first-publication rates within a common window, publication time, targeted-checkpoint retention and predefined guardrails exemplified by publication errors. These reporting and measurement instructions do not assert observed outcomes or additional inferential relations.

The field consists of conditional inferential relations, limits and decision rules covered by the listed claims. P022's fallback condition is reconstructed with P021; it is not treated as an unconditional instruction.

The field consists of substantive limitations and responses with stated rationales, all covered above. The listed corroborating methods are alternatives within one proposed response, not separate promises of causal identification.
